As Target (TGT) Stock Rose, Shareholder Eaton Vance Management Trimmed Position; Sp Plus (SP) Holder Dimensional Fund Advisors LP Has Raised Holding by $1.05 Million as Stock Declined
May 1, 2018 - By Michael Collier
Dimensional Fund Advisors Lp increased its stake in Sp Plus Corp (SP) by 2.66% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Dimensional Fund Advisors Lp bought 28,423 shares as the company’s stock declined 6.41% with the market. The institutional investor held 1.10 million shares of the rental and leasing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $40.67M, up from 1.07M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Dimensional Fund Advisors Lp who had been investing in Sp Plus Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $786.07M market cap company. The stock increased 0.14% or $0.05 $35.2. About 47,896 shares traded. SP Plus Corporation (NASDAQ:SP) has risen 5.61% since May 1, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 5.94% the S&P500.
Eaton Vance Management decreased its stake in Target Corp (TGT) by 25.8% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Eaton Vance Management sold 33,210 shares as the company’s stock rose 4.77% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 95,493 shares of the department and specialty retail stores company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $6.23 million, down from 128,703 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Eaton Vance Management who had been investing in Target Corp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $38.48B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.63% or $1.18 $71.42. About 1.86 million shares traded. Target Corporation (NYSE:TGT) has risen 28.46% since May 1, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 16.91% the S&P500.
Among 3 analysts covering SP Plus ( NASDAQ:SP ), 3 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 0 Hold. Therefore 100% are positive. Barrington maintained the stock with “Buy” rating in Monday, March 5 report. UBS maintained SP Plus Corporation (NASDAQ:SP) on Friday, September 4 with “Buy” rating.

It also reduced its holding in Cogent Communications Hldgs (NASDAQ:CCOI) by 88,649 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 1.33M shares, and cut its stake in First Solar Inc (NASDAQ:FSLR).
